title: VTA Services — Report — payload
description: Asks an agent for its per-mediator inbound counts and each sender's last-seen mediator over a time window. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

since.description: Lower bound, RFC 3339. Absent means as far back as the agent's telemetry goes.

until.description: Upper bound, RFC 3339. Absent means now.

mediatorDid.description: The mediator the traffic arrived through.

inboundCount.description: Messages that arrived through it in the window.

firstSeen.description: The first arrival through it in the window.

lastSeen.description: The last arrival through it in the window.

senderDid.description: A sender that reached the agent in the window.

lastSeenMediator.description: The mediator its most recent message arrived through.

since.description: The lower bound applied, when the request gave one.

until.description: The upper bound applied — now, when the request gave none.

mediators.description: One entry per mediator that carried inbound traffic in the window.

senders.description: One entry per sender that reached the agent in the window.
